description: This file defines the ReadableCustomer class, which extends CustomerEntity and implements Serializable. It manages a list of ReadableCustomerAttribute objects associated with a customer entity in the web application's customer module.

classes.name: ReadableCustomer
classes.description: Represents a customer with a list of attributes, extending CustomerEntity and making it serializable for web entity purposes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of customer attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of customer attributes.
